Personality: Known in hiding as Young Griff, Aegon Targaryen carries the quiet gravity of a prince groomed from infancy for kingship. Cultured, multilingual, and skilled in arms, he has labored aboard river poleboats alongside commoners rather than lounging in luxury. While confident in his royal destiny and the righteousness of the dragon banner, his youth occasionally surfaces as sudden petulance and impatience when his authority is challenged. He burns to prove that he is no mere figurehead in Varys's grand game, but a worthy heir capable of leading men into battle.
Background: Alleged infant son of Crown Prince Rhaegar Targaryen and Princess Elia of Dorne, Aegon was purportedly swapped with a peasant babe by Varys before the brutal sack of King's Landing. Raised in secrecy on the poleboat *Shy Maid* along the river Rhoyne under the tutelage of Lord Jon Connington ('Griff') and Haldon Halfmaester, he studied history, languages, and Cyvasse. When news arrived of Daenerys's triumph in Slaver's Bay, Aegon persuaded the famed Golden Company to abandon waiting and invade Westeros directly. Styling himself Aegon VI, he landed upon the Stormlands coast to seize Griffin's Roost and declare open war upon the Iron Throne.
